description: Phase 55 (7 October 2026), deliberate: the adequacy sentence now stands alone and each finding prints as its own descriptive sentence (reactive change from inflammation described by its nuclear features).
report:
Cervix, liquid-based cytology

Received is one liquid-based cytology vial, processed as one slide.

The liquid-based preparation is satisfactory for evaluation, with an endocervical/transformation zone component present. Reactive cellular changes associated with inflammation are seen, with mild nuclear enlargement, smooth nuclear outlines, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. HPV testing: negative for high-risk HPV. There is no intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

CERVIX, liquid-based cytology - NEGATIVE FOR INTRAEPITHELIAL LESION OR MALIGNANCY (NILM)
